rules.title: Los Angeles RSO allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For units under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, rent may be raised only once every 12 months, and only by the allowable rent increase percentage LAHD publishes. Rent may reset to market when a tenant voluntarily leaves, takes a buyout, or is evicted for specified at-fault reasons.
rules.key_value: Once every 12 months by LAHD allowable percentage
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties in the City of Los Angeles first built on or before October 1, 1978. Also covers replacement units under LAMC 151.28. Covered types include apartments, condos, townhomes, duplexes, two or more single-family dwellings on one parcel, hotel/motel rooms occupied over 30 days, residential units attached to commercial buildings, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes.
rules.exemptions: Rent amount is not regulated for condominium and townhome tenancies that began after December 31, 1995. A luxury exemption is available if the owner can establish the monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978. Temporary exemptions may be filed.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Replacement units under LAMC 151.28 are covered regardless of age. The condo/townhome exemption depends on tenancy start date (after 12/31/1995). The luxury exemption depends on the 1978 rent level.

rules.title: RSO: no additional percentage increase for utilities
rules.requirement: As of February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units can no longer add an additional percentage increase for utilities on top of the allowable annual increase.
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO units in the City of Los Angeles (generally built on or before October 1, 1978).
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), LAMC Ch. XV
rules.quoted_span: Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.

rules.title: RSO: additional tenant/dependent rent increase
rules.requirement: As of February 2, 2026, landlords may not add a 10% increase for an additional dependent added to the tenancy. A 10% increase is still allowed for an additional non-dependent tenant, if imposed within 60 days of the landlord learning of that tenant.
rules.key_value: 10% for additional non-dependent tenant; 0% for dependents
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO units in the City of Los Angeles.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Depends on whether the added occupant is a dependent and on timing of notice.

rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), LAMC Ch. XV
rules.quoted_span: Effective February 2, 2026, an additonal 10% increase for an additional dependent added to the tenancy is no longer permitted.

rules.title: RSO legal reasons for eviction and no-fault relocation assistance
rules.requirement: RSO tenants may be evicted only for listed at-fault reasons (e.g., nonpayment, lease violation, nuisance, illegal use, denial of access) or listed no-fault reasons (owner/family move-in, resident manager, demolition/removal from market, government order, conversion to affordable housing). No-fault evictions require relocation assistance, and all termination notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service.

rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance for non-RSO units
rules.requirement: Rental properties not covered by the RSO are still subject to the city's Just Cause Ordinance, which limits evictions to legal reasons. Eviction notices must be filed with LAHD.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties in the City of Los Angeles not covered by the RSO.
